maps.name: 내부 지도
maps.desc: 존 소렌센(John Sorenson)의「몰몬의 지도」를 기반으로 그려진 약속의 땅 내부 관련 지도

maps.name: BYU
maps.desc: BYU Virtual Scriptures’ artistic rendering that gives basic idea of approximate directions and theoretical relationships between various geographical features mentioned in the Book of Mormon.

maps.name: Fullmer
maps.desc: James Fullmer’s artistic rendering based on the scholarship of John L. Sorenson in “Mormon’s Map.”

maps.name: CES
maps.desc: Church Education System’s published possible relationships of sites in the Book of Mormon, based on internal evidence. No effort should be made to identify points on this map with any existing geographical location. The map spans Jaredite and Nephite/Lamanite periods during which settlements changed over time."

maps.name: 중앙아메리카

maps.name: Yucatan
